items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: he'd have Lee Collins there and Mac Portland you know when

ctx.x: he was a very wonderful fellow I only knew him a couple of nights you might say we were working on the book Jazzman I went there to interview him in 1938 I remember one Monday session maybe more than one at that time he didn't seem to be playing regularly I mean he had this little restaurant so he must have given up music professionally
he wouldn't hold a lip and like I say he'd have Lee Collins there and Mac Portland you know when
his last regular job was though
